content: Tamamata 'aitsikayari
Kakaɨyari 'aitsika kaniwayetuirieni, 'inɨari niukiyari memetimanikɨ:
«Netsɨ Yawé nekanihɨkɨtɨni 'akakaɨyari. Ne nepɨmatsi'ayewitɨ 'Ekipitu, hakewa waɨkawa pemɨre'uximayakai pekarepitɨarietɨ.
»Hipame tawarita kakaɨyarixi pepɨkawarayexeiyani ne xeikɨa.
»Tixaɨtɨ pepɨkatiwewieka taheima mieme hepaɨ ti'anekame, kwiepa memɨtexuawe hepaɨ ti'anekame, meta hapa memɨteye'uwa hepaɨ ti'anekame meta kwie hetɨa memɨtexuawe.

Mɨkɨ wahɨxie pepɨkatitunumakekani, pepɨkawarayexeiyani. Ne, Yawé 'akakaɨyari nemɨtiyukakwerie nekanihɨkɨtɨni. Kepauka wapaapama 'axamemɨte'u'iyari kepauka memɨnetsixani'erie, ne waniwema nepɨwa'uximatɨa, wateukarima, watutsima meta mɨkɨ waniwema.
Matsi kepauka, memɨnetsinaki'erie, kepauka yamemɨtekahu ne'aitsikatsie, ne nenaki'eriya wahetsiemieme matsiɨkɨme nekanayeitɨwani xeimiriyari nuiwariyaritsie.
»Ne Yawé kenemɨtitewa yakɨ xeikɨa pepɨkanetsikuxatani, ne nepɨka'itinenimayata kemɨ'ane kanetsi'enietɨ mɨnetsi'utaterɨwani.
»Kena'eriwani xawati tukari, patsiekame xemeyexeiyanikɨ.
'Ataxewime tukari xeikɨa pepɨti'uximayaka, tsepa naimekɨ kepemɨti'uximayaka pɨyɨweni,

peru 'atahutarieka tukaritsie pepɨka'uxipieni pemeyexeiyanikɨ Yawé 'akakaɨyari. Mɨkɨ tukaritsie pepɨkati'uximayaka meta 'aniwema 'ukitsi 'ukari, meta te'a'uximayatsiriwamete 'ukari 'ukitsi meta 'atewama meta teewanarixi 'akiekaritsie memɨtitei.

Kena'eriwani 'ataxewime tukari Yawé pɨtiutiwewi muyuawi, kwie, haramara, meta yunaime mana memɨteye'uwa, hikɨ 'atahutarieka kaniuka'uxipieni. 'Ayumieme Yawé mɨkɨ 'uxipiya tukari patsiekame kanayeitɨani.
»Keniwareu'enieka 'apaapa meta 'amaama, mɨpaɨ petiyurienetɨ 'apepɨreutere kwiepa Yawé 'akakaɨyari mɨmatsipitɨa.
»Pepɨkati'amemiwani.
»Xeime 'ɨyaya kɨnaya pepɨkakumaɨwani.
»Pepɨkatinawayani.
»Xeime 'a'iwatsie pepɨkatiuhɨpani 'itarikakɨ.
»'A'iwa kiiya pepɨkahiwe'erieka, meta 'ɨyaya, meta 'iparewiwameya 'uki 'uka, meta tuuruya, puxuya, naime tita mɨrexeiya pepɨkatihiwe'erieka».
'Ixaheritsixi kememɨte'utimama
Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi kepauka memi'eniekai tɨranari meta kepauka merɨkariya memɨxeiyakai meta kɨtsi hɨritsie matineikakaikɨ kwinimieme mekatenimamakaitɨni 'ateewa mekaniti'ukaitɨni.
Hikɨ Muitsexi mɨpaɨ mekateniutahɨawe: —'Ekɨ ketatinekuxaxatɨwani, tepɨmatsi'enieka. Xɨka Kakaɨyari tatiutaxatɨani xɨari tepɨkwini.
Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xepɨkamamaka, Kakaɨyari kaninuani xeta'inɨatake, xe'eyemakatɨ, 'axaxemɨkateyuriekakɨ.
Hikɨ Muitsexi 'ahurawa kaniuyani haiwitɨri mɨka'anuyehekɨatsie Kakaɨyari hakewa mewekai, peru 'ixaheritsixi 'ateewa mekaniti'ukaitɨni.
Mawari taiyame tenariyari
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katinita'aitɨani: «'Ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ ketiniwarutahɨawi: “Xeme xekatenimaika muyuawitsiepai nekanixe'utahɨawe.
Xepɨkanetsi hiweritɨaka, kakaɨyarixi pɨratakɨ meta hurukɨ xepɨkawawewieka meta wahɨxie xepɨka'ukatunuma'uweni.

Mɨrayutimawatɨre tenariyari xekeneneutawewiri kwiepa, mana mawari taiyariyari xemɨnetsi'utiwewiriwanikɨ meta mana kename 'aixɨa meteyuxeiyani hepaɨtsita, muxatsi meta tuurutsixi xewamawatɨ. Ne nepunuani hakewa xemɨnetsihahɨaweni, hikɨ 'aixɨa nepɨxeyurieni.
Xɨka mawari wewiwame xenetsi'utawewirieni tetexikɨ, xepɨka'itiparekutɨwani tixaɨtɨkɨ tepɨakɨ, mɨkɨ tetexi kapatsiekame payeitɨwa.
'Imɨmɨi xepɨkaheukuwewiwani nemawari wewiwametsie, manutiyanitsie mɨka'anamamawerenikɨ”.
